future_activation_rules: A capability that can persist PII must reference a defined data class.
A PII-enabled data class must define a finite retention_days value and a deletion_path before capability activation.
Secrets, tokens, passwords, cookies and recovery values are never permitted in HAE payload/event retention classes.
Analytics and public receipts must receive only minimized non-PII projections.
No automated purge is enabled until the owner-approved retention policy is recorded.
runtime_enforcement_note: This file classifies allowed data policy but does not itself sanitize or reject arbitrary job payload fields. PII-bearing or secret-bearing ingestion requires a separate enforced minimization/redaction gate before activation.
